title: ghost-recover
summary: Scans a project's hidden D-RAG folder for recovery journals left behind when a ghost-check overlay was interrupted by a crash
intro: Read this after a crash during a buffer compile (ghost-check), so no unit is left holding unsaved-buffer content. ghost-recover finds leftover recovery journals under the project D-RAG folder and restores each file; it prints that nothing is pending when all is clean.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint ghost-recover <dproj> (restore any file left overlaid by an INTERRUPTED ghost-check)
help: drag-lint ghost-recover <dproj>   (restore any file left overlaid by an INTERRUPTED ghost-check)
Safe to run any time: prints "nothing pending." when there is nothing to do.
